name: print-social-become-a-streamer-posts-dark-blue-pink-neon-swirl
title: 'Become a Streamer' pack in dark blue with pink-blue neon swirl shapes and dual-tone gaming photos
whatItIs: Five dark navy square posts with glossy pink-to-blue neon swirl shapes, bordered photos of gamers lit in blue and pink gel light using controllers and headsets, bold headlines ('Become a Streamer', 'Stream Without Any Interruptions', 'Live Streaming Service'), and a pink 'Join Us' pill tag.
whatItMeans: Energetic and modern; glossy neon swirls give a streaming service the same vibrant, produced feel as the content it promotes.
techniques: Use glossy gradient swirl shapes as a recurring background motif.
Light subject photos with dual-colour neon gels.
Border photos in a thin bright frame for a screen-like pop.

vocabulary.definition: A glossy curved gradient form used as decoration.
Coloured lighting used to tint a photo dramatically.
